messages:
evan: kicking off quantized onboard for raven-v3q (int8). running funcall conformance suite. observed intermittent structured-output parse failures — not full failures, the model emits trailing characters after JSON a few percent of the time. attaching sample logs.

maya: saw similar on the int8 canary yesterday. parse_fail_rate ~1.2% on smallish corpus, but 0.2% on fp16 baseline. latency/throughput ok. maybe tokenization or streaming cutoff?

cheng: paste logs

cheng: ```
...{"action": "call", "tool": "lookup", "args": {"id": 42}}
}}}
```

ana: looks like extra closing braces and a stray newline — could be streaming boundary. are we using `kvcache` prefix batching for this canary?

evan: yes default kvbatch enabled. disabling prefix batching reduces failures to ~0.3% locally. suspect kvcache tokenization alignment after quant kernels.

maya: canary-bot reports surge correlated with batch_size=16 and seq>512. sub-run with batch_size=8 scheduled. @cheng can you run the parse-heuristic metric on the latest trace?

cheng: running now. quick grep shows post-tokenization char entropy spike around token_id 5023 (newline + 0x1f). saving sample payload: ```
{"response": {"status":"ok"}, "_suffix":"\x1f\n"}
```

ana: two quick mitigations: 1) add soft postprocess to strip control chars and run `json5` repair as rescue, 2) implement 200ms streaming flush at EOS to prevent partial tail tokens.

evan: want an eval plan before touching repair. proposal: run 50k queries across benchmark set with three configs: fp16 baseline, int8 kvbatch, int8 kvbatch+suffix-scrub. measure parse_fail_rate, downstream tool error rate, and end-to-end obj accuracy. assign @maya to collect metrics, @cheng to run experiments.

maya: ack. will spin up jobs, ETA 3h. will post summary here with CSV snippet.

ops-bot: job 6490001245 started: raven-v3q-int8-kvbatch-50k.

canary-bot: canary alert (parse-fail_rate) -> 1.15% rolling 1h, threshold 0.5%.

evan: thanks. if scrub reduces failures without harming accuracy we can add to onboard patch. otherwise we may need to iterate quant kernel or tokenization alignment with infra.

maya: quick CSV sample: `config,parse_fail_rate,tool_error_rate,acc_delta`\n`fp16,0.20,0.18,0.00`\n`int8-kv16,1.15,1.30,-0.9`\n`int8-kv16+scrub,0.25,0.22,-0.05`

cheng: saving trace ids 7890..7899 for postmortem. will try a micro reproducible example with streaming disabled.

evan: great. follow up in ~4h. :thumbsup:
